meta.counting_convention: Vessels: one record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left as separate records, mirroring the skeletal and muscular modules); one record for an un-sided class concept modelled jointly; a class with branch-class children but no lateralised instances is one un-sided record; a lateralised concept whose side-stripped class does not exist in the release is one record keyed on the concept itself (single-sided by definition). Structural roots, tree classes, families, subdivisions, segments and set concepts are not records. Heart: the organ and the aorta are records keyed on their PART-OF-only organ concepts; named chambers, valves and the fibrous skeleton are records keyed on PART-OF concepts; specific valve cusps/leaflets and papillary muscles are records keyed on IS-A concepts; walls, cavities, regions and generic part classes are concepts, not records.
